from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Total profit reported for a single company in its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities/stock code of the company")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written, e.g. '利润总额'")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total profit amount, negative indicates loss")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_records: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
